response.query: What exact primary feasibility and signal-of-effect endpoints (with numeric cutoffs) will determine scale-up, adaptation, or stop decisions for the pilot?
response.answer: Primary feasibility and signal-of-effect endpoints for pilot scale-up are intervention effect size and acceptability metrics, with numeric cutoffs set at 30% effect size and 70% acceptability. Decisions will be based on these metrics.
